note: Gate G1: the word-count range of each FORMAT per locale (tags stripped, FAQ included). The calendar's length_target names a format. Arabic runs ~25% shorter than French for the same content and English ~10%; the ranges follow. G2–G4 (answer-first 40–55 words, ≥4 question H2s, FAQ 5–6 items) apply to every format.
faq_answer_note: Three ranges exist and the strictest binds. scripts/seo-audit.js fails a FAQPage answer outside 25–75 words on production and runs in CI; CLAUDE.md's on-page limits say 40–60, the editorial target; this brief said 30–90. A gate must never pass what a later gate fails, so G4's ceiling is 75. The 36 pre-contract posts end their last FAQ item with a closing WhatsApp CTA carrying no heading, so extractFaq reads it as part of that answer (81–116 words). They are not edited: src/lib/article-schema.js emits FAQPage only when EVERY answer sits in 25–75, so they emit none — which is what they did before this system added FAQPage to the article page — and a post written to the contract earns one.
